all six law groups are written there, so the ring and the face compete for one square of ground and neither can be moved to cheaper ground

the far side of the one standing tear is an agreement rather than a place, two frames reachable only where they agree on one law group at one value, so a threshold facing inward cannot be reached to test

the densest bodies in the setting stop at realm seventeen and nobody present could see that it was a composition result rather than a discipline failure, so the ceiling is still there and still unexplained
nobody is paid to have the explanation, and whoever benefits from an unexplained ceiling wants the hole shut, so the assay figure is published before any sale and the reason is not measured
it is a hole you can stand in and see the end of, so the only place a claim about scarcity can be checked by anybody is the place nobody wants checked
its charter renews only while the measured figure keeps falling, and stagnation does not void it while silence does, so the company profits from the number continuing to fall
its method is to seat a law and diff what the tier newly permits, which needs the figure published to know which law is missing and where to move a student
the surplus rises off the Immortal Court and behaves like weather, so the ley and the shelf are one system and holding either means negotiating with a supply line neither owns
ten slots over six groups leaves four duplicate imprints with nowhere on the surface to sit, which is the first ground in the setting where fire is simply fire and is licensed twice

the two lower tiers left elemental law unspent so a fire affinity ran at full strength and produced nothing, and the same technique works here, which is the whole of the asymmetry that draws every fire practitioner
it is the only body that may observe the floor and it is staffed by a very small and very old body whose reading may not be explained, so it grants recognition and nothing else
it is the only body that holds ground on the tier below, and assay and defence want the same square and neither can be moved up
fifteen slots over three layers leave nine surplus imprints and nowhere to go but up, so access there is a discipline rather than a journey
nothing there grows, recovers, adapts or is cheap, so a place given wrongly is not corrected later but simply lost and the tier's ecology is a ranking rather than a web
it cannot be a candidate for any terrace, which is the whole of its defence and costs nothing to state
it tends the floor and a queue is one ordering, so two bodies placing names at the front produce an ordering nobody may obey
it stands there because a self leaving its body needs spatial law read high enough for a self larger than its container, and broken law is the only substrate that will host one
it colonises worked stone wherever a large quantity of qi has been drawn through it and the trace never washes off, so the court's floor doubles as its own evidence
possession of the trial is possession of the substrate and there is no second site, so a ring relocated to fresher stone loses the record and a record that moves is a record a loser may erase
a dao fragment cures as it decays so the claim's value falls with time and a holder without a buyer is holding a liability
it seats a law and diffs what the tier newly permits, which is the only experiment that can be run on ground where three attempts have ever been possible and fewer survived

time runs ten to a hundred times faster there, which is what makes the race short enough for a standoff to dissolve into the resource it was racing toward
its value falls monotonically, so a shared claim converts a race into a queue nobody can win
it worked the tailings elsewhere and moved to the cured end, which is why both parties ended up selling the same thing
at the top tier one repetition of a strained reading costs a lifetime, so the work is done by a very small and very old body during an hour nobody may explain

on every tier below the same hour is spent keeping a hum no buyer admits to making, and nobody is obliged to say who is making it
it loses the repetition its readings depend on if the settlement's claim is accepted, and the hum is nobody's labour so there is no owner to compensate
a world boundary is the edge of a law budget and not a wall between neighbours, so arriving where a group the body relied on is unwritten injures rather than slows
it is a collapsed pocket and a collapsed frame does not announce itself, so the lodge's customers find out at the crossing, which is precisely where the guild's walls are
it holds a population it cannot make and cannot retune on the far side, because a body tuned for a collapsed frame arrives wrong and stays wrong

it records that a spare seat is not capacity for a new path but the only condition under which a law can be studied instead of obeyed, which is the finding the academy would give up

the ground seats physical, life and qi and leaves three groups unwritten, so the primer has three entries and cannot be extended, which makes it a description of this world rather than a syllabus

caging a forming core in iron is the one craft the tier is trusted with, so a household that cannot afford the ore cannot attempt the gate at all
nothing about this body's anatomy favours a path, so the only thing standing between it and a gate is the one material the tier has run out of
